title: Ndị Bi n'Ubi Abụọ ahụ
intro: N'ala ebe ngọzi na-asọpụta nke ukwuu, otu obodo nwere ọtụtụ ubi abụọ mara mma n'oge gara aga. Ndụ ha bụ ihe akaebe nke amara Chineke, mana akụkọ ha gbanwere mgbe ekele dara, nke dugara na mgbanwe nke ga-aghọ ihe ịrịba ama na-adịgide adịgide maka ndị niile na-atụgharị uche.
clues: Anyị bụ ndị e ji ala dị jụụ na ihe bara ụba gọzie.
Onyenwe anyị nyere anyị ubi abụọ mara mma, nke jupụtara n'ubi ma na-amị mkpụrụ n'akụkụ niile.
E nyere anyị iwu ka anyị nwee ekele, mana anyị họọrọ enweghị ekele wee laghachi azụ.
Nnukwu mmiri mgbochi mmiri gbochiri mmiri nke nyere ala anyị ndụ.
Mgbe anyị nọgidere na-eme ihe ọjọọ anyị, mmiri ahụ gbawara, idei mmiri ahụ wee gbasaa.
E jiri mkpụrụ osisi ilu, tamarisks, na osisi lote ole na ole dochie ubi anyị mara mma nke ukwuu.

trial.answer: Idei mmiri na-emebi ihe sitere na mmiri mgbochi mmiri gbawara agbawa

outcome.label: Nsonaazụ
options: E jiri mkpụrụ osisi na-elu ilu na obere osisi dochie ubi anyị.
Ala ọma jijiji lodara anyị n'ala ahụ
A gbanwere anyị ka anyị ghọọ enwe na ezi
outcome.answer: E jiri mkpụrụ osisi na-elu ilu na obere osisi dochie ubi anyị.

arabic: فَأَعْرَضُوا۟ فَأَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ سَيْلَ ٱلْعَرِمِ وَبَدَّلْنَـٰهُم بِجَنَّتَيْهِمْ جَنَّتَيْنِ ذَوَاتَىْ أُكُلٍ خَمْطٍۢ وَأَثْلٍۢ وَشَىْءٍۢ مِّن سِدْرٍۢ قَلِيلٍۢ
verse: But they turned away [refusing], so We sent upon them the flood of the dam, and We replaced their two [fields of] gardens with gardens of bitter fruit, tamarisks and something of sparse lote trees. (34:16)
